checkpoints.description: Task 'tessera-transforms-v1' completed successfully.

[1/2] Add the Loom and Drift motif builders and the Terra and Iris palettes, with seeded variation and generic catalogue tests; [2/2] document the new rows, capture both looks, bump to 0.5.0 and rerun every gate

impact_assessment.why: The studio has six motifs and six palettes; the catalogue is the product, and Loom (woven over-and-under bands) and Drift (dotted sine currents) add distinct structures while Terra and Iris fill the warm-earth and cool-jewel gaps.
impact_assessment.benefits: Eight motifs and eight palettes make 64 pairings; both motifs use the existing seeded, role-based, 100x100 tile contract, so they gain transforms, PNG/SVG export and the gallery for free.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none beyond two new validated motif and palette ids; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: existing URLs and gallery entries keep their ids and render unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Generic determinism, role and palette tests cover every id; explicit catalogue tests pin the new entries; screenshots inspect both looks; the responsive sweep rechecks 320-1920 after the extra thumbnail rows.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Loom and Drift motifs plus Terra and Iris palettes shipped: 8 motifs, 8 palettes, README rows and screenshot URLs, v0.5.0. 102 Node tests in budget, 4/4 project gates, static contract; headless screenshots verified Loom/Terra and Drift/Iris and an 8/8 motif and palette grid; no overflow at 320/390/768/1024/1440/1920. checklists: passed

checkpoints.description: Task 'tessera-motifs-v1' completed successfully.

[1/6] Plan six continuous improvement cycles for Tessera: honest motif-picker previews, keyboard shortcuts after button focus, gallery restore feedback, export verification, mobile readability, and stage interaction polish; each cycle carries before/after screenshots plus a scripted play run

impact_assessment.why: The studio is feature-complete for v0.5.x, but scripted play found stale motif previews and shortcuts that stop after a button click; the remaining cycles will inspect the gallery, export and mobile surfaces for the same class of feedback gaps.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each shipped cycle is a small, test-backed fix with browser evidence, so the studio stays visually truthful and keyboard-fast without adding dependencies or changing the state format.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no runtime contract change beyond a pure thumbKey helper; dependency: none; concurrency: one writer per state and gallery record; state: no URL or localStorage schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add failing pure/static tests first, keep each diff limited to one area, and verify with the same seeded 1440x900 CDP run before and after; the full npm, static-contract and AIKit gates run before every commit.
